content:
Apple has just released iOS 27 fifth beta and accompanying updates, but at the same time also launched unexpected second wave test versions such as iOS 26.6.1 and macOS 26.6.2.

iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1 and macOS 26.6.2 beta versions make their appearance

If you have been using Apple's beta software, today you have two options.

After a three-week wait, the iOS 27 fifth beta has finally arrived, marking Apple's continued push throughout the summer in preparation for the next major software release.

But Apple has also just rolled out a new round of beta versions for iOS 26 and its accompanying updates.

The first beta versions of iOS 26.6.1, iPadOS 26.6.1 and macOS 26.6.2 have been released.

Apple typically does not provide beta versions for these smaller updates, but instead chooses to roll them out directly without prior notice.

These updates may replace larger updates such as iOS 26.7. But whatever the reason, Apple clearly believes it is necessary to release these new iOS 26 updates as beta versions first before making them available to the public.

The iOS 26.6.1 and similar updates are expected to contain only security updates and bug fixes. If any specific changes are discovered, we will continue to report on them.

Note: If you have already upgraded your iPhone to the iOS 27 beta, you will not see the option to install iOS 26.6.1. That update is only for devices still running iOS 26.

Are you still using iOS 26? Have you noticed any differences in the iOS 26.6.1 beta? Let us know in the comments section.
